title: Positioning
description: CFTC Commitments of Traders. Net position of a cohort group as a share of open interest, with the underlying price above and open interest below. Percentile ranks are causal and precomputed in pandas by scripts/build -- see that module for why they are not SQL.

list.name: dataset
list.label: Report family
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT dataset FROM board_positioning ORDER BY dataset

list.name: market
list.label: Market
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT market_code FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' ORDER BY market_code

list.name: group
list.label: Cohort group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT cohort_group FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' ORDER BY cohort_group

panels.title: Price ($market)
panels.description: The mapped underlying, sampled as-of each Tuesday report date, backward only and staleness-capped at 10 days. A price beside a position is contemporaneous with the position, not with the moment it was published.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts/1000 AS time, price AS 'price' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY ts
targets.queryText: SELECT ts/1000 AS time, price AS 'price' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Net position as % of open interest
panels.description: Net (long minus short) of the selected cohort group, over the market's open interest. Dimensionless, so a contract re-specification cancels top and bottom.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts/1000 AS time, share AS '% of open interest' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY ts
targets.queryText: SELECT ts/1000 AS time, share AS '% of open interest' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Open interest (contracts)
panels.description: On screen because a share can move when the cohort trades or when open interest does, and the share alone cannot say which.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts/1000 AS time, open_interest AS 'open interest' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY ts
targets.queryText: SELECT ts/1000 AS time, open_interest AS 'open interest' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Latest reading
panels.description: The percentile is causal -- each week ranked only against weeks up to and including itself -- and computed within the market's current contract-unit segment for open interest. n_pool is how many weeks the share's rank is measured against.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT share AS '% of OI', share_pctile AS 'share pctile', oi_pctile AS 'OI pctile', chg_2w AS 'change over 2w', n_pool AS 'weeks ranked against' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
targets.queryText: SELECT share AS '% of OI', share_pctile AS 'share pctile', oi_pctile AS 'OI pctile', chg_2w AS 'change over 2w', n_pool AS 'weeks ranked against' FROM board_positioning WHERE dataset='$dataset' AND market_code='$market' AND cohort_group='$group' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
